related.title: Google QPU：Hahn echo 與低頻雜訊辨識
related.titleEn: Google QPU: Hahn echo and low-frequency noise discrimination
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付速率分解表、失效例與量測同步條件。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver a rate decomposition, invalid example and acquisition-synchronization conditions. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Google QPU：Hahn echo 與低頻雜訊辨識』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付等時窗對照、脈衝基線及噪聲頻段假說。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Google QPU: Hahn echo and low-frequency noise discrimination', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver equal-window comparisons, pulse baseline and a noise-band hypothesis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：馬可夫指數模型1/T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tφ；非指數或準靜態雜訊時只是有效參數。 使用合成 T1=100 μs、T2*=80 μs，所有倒數用μs⁻¹。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/(1/80-1/(2*100))，另開一欄執行獨立核對：將反算的Tφ代回速率總和；再試T2*=250 μs並標記負速率代表模型或量測矛盾。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：以 C(t)=exp(−t/T2)比較有效Ramsey與echo包絡；echo不消除能量鬆弛，亦非所有雜訊都可重聚焦。 使用教學t=40 μs、Ramsey有效T2=60 μs、echo有效T2=120 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-40/60)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對兩序列總延遲相同；用t=0正規化並把額外π脈衝誤差另外列出。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: The Markov exponential model gives1/T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tφ; for nonexponential or quasistatic noise this is only effective. Use Synthetic T1=100 μs and T2*=80 μs; all rates use μs⁻¹. Evaluate nominal expression 1/(1/80-1/(2*100)) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Substitute recovered Tφ into the rate sum; test T2*=250 μs and flag the negative rate as model or measurement inconsistency.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Compare effective Ramsey and echo envelopes C(t)=exp(−t/T2); echo removes neither relaxation nor every noise process. Use Teaching t=40 μs, effective Ramsey T2=60 μs and echo T2=120 μs. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-40/60) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Match total delays, normalize at t=0 and separately account for the extra π-pulse error.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 超導讀出工程：Purcell 衰減與濾波取捨
related.titleEn: Superconducting readout engineering: Purcell decay and filtering
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付速率分解表、失效例與量測同步條件。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

Final handover must include: Deliver a rate decomposition, invalid example and acquisition-synchronization conditions. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.

related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Superconducting readout engineering: Purcell decay and filtering', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a decay-rate ledger,2π unit check and readout/lifetime tradeoff plot.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：馬可夫指數模型1/T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tφ；非指數或準靜態雜訊時只是有效參數。 使用合成 T1=100 μs、T2*=80 μs，所有倒數用μs⁻¹。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/(1/80-1/(2*100))，另開一欄執行獨立核對：將反算的Tφ代回速率總和；再試T2*=250 μs並標記負速率代表模型或量測矛盾。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：單模弱耦合代理ΓP=(g/Δ)²κ，κ是能量衰減率s⁻¹，TP=1/ΓP；此處不含濾波器頻率響應。 使用教學g/Δ=0.05、κ=2π×1 MHz；求TP以μs表示。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/((0.05)**2*2*pi*1e6)*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：驗證比例減半使衰減率四分之一、壽命四倍；確認κ不是直接1 MHz。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: The Markov exponential model gives1/T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tφ; for nonexponential or quasistatic noise this is only effective. Use Synthetic T1=100 μs and T2*=80 μs; all rates use μs⁻¹. Evaluate nominal expression 1/(1/80-1/(2*100)) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Substitute recovered Tφ into the rate sum; test T2*=250 μs and flag the negative rate as model or measurement inconsistency.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Single-mode weak-coupling proxy ΓP=(g/Δ)²κ uses energy-decay rate κ in s⁻¹, with TP=1/ΓP; filter response is omitted. Use Teaching g/Δ=0.05 and κ=2π×1 MHz; express TP in μs. Evaluate nominal expression 1/((0.05)**2*2*pi*1e6)*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Verify halving the ratio quarters decay rate and quadruples lifetime; ensure κ was not mistaken for1 MHz.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
